releaseNotes: Drawer decoy icons can now be managed in bulk. App Details gains a Selection mode with Select All and Deselect All, plus bulk Enable and Disable actions (and Select All + Enable / Select All + Disable) so multiple apps' decoy launcher icons can be enabled or disabled together, with live progress and an honest per-app result summary (successful, failed, skipped) while unselected apps are left untouched. This release also carries the 1.0.127 schedule fixes: Time Hide begins at the schedule start, deleting a schedule no longer releases apps that must stay hidden, same-hour one-time schedules anchor to the correct window, and released apps are no longer pulled back into the fail-closed re-hide loop.
